notes.text: SCOPE: personale tecnico-amministrativo of the universities and AOU (Aree Operatori, Collaboratori, Funzionari, Elevate Professionalità) and Collaboratori ed esperti linguistici, from 1.1.2024 (new classification of art. 92 CCNL 18/1/2024 from 1.5.2024, the earlier areas transposed by its allegato F). Tables: CCNL 2022-2024 Tabelle B2-B4 and CCNL 2025-2027 Tabelle B2-B4. The tecnologi a tempo indeterminato (Tabella B2 from 1.3.2026, posizioni stipendiali) are modelled in universita-tecnologi-aran. Not modelled: the differenziali economici di professionalità, which the caller pays as allowances. The Elevate Professionalità have no overtime table (B4). (review of 2026-10-30)

SHARED RULES: the hourly divisor, the tredicesima, the leave, absence, sickness and accrual rules are those of the scuola file of the same comparto (istruzione-ricerca-aran), not read again for the university staff.

limitation.remediation: Read the university sections of the CCNL 2019-2021 (18/1/2024) for leave, absence and sickness.

notes.text: PENSION FUND: the university staff join the Fondo Perseo Sirio, not modelled here (the scuola fund Espero does not apply).

limitation.remediation: Model the employer and employee rates of Fondo Perseo Sirio.

provenance.note: No text of the comparto fixes the daily quota of an unpaid absence of the scuola staff: the only daily divisor in the texts read is the 1/30 of the compenso individuale accessorio (CCNL Scuola 2007, p. 75). by_26 is kept as extracted, not sourced. Searched on 2026-10-12: the trade press reports a deduction of 1/30 of the taxable monthly pay for a day of strike and 1/30 of the RPD or CIA for the first ten days of sickness (NoiPA practice), but no statute, CCNL or NoiPA document read gives the daily quota of an unpaid absence; it stays assumed until one is found.

source_document.title: CCNL Comparto Scuola 2006-2009, 29 novembre 2007

location.section: Art. 13 cc. 2-4 (ferie)
location.quote: I dipendenti neo-assunti nella scuola hanno diritto a 30 giorni lavorativi di ferie

provenance.transformation: 32 days (c. 2), 30 for the first 3 years of service (cc. 3-4: 'Dopo 3 anni di servizio, a qualsiasi titolo prestato'). The CCNL counts the three years in any public administration ('a qualsiasi titolo prestato' / 'presso una qualsiasi pubblica amministrazione'); the tiers read the seniority with this employer, so a worker with earlier public service gets 26 (30) days when the text gives 28 (32): state the seniority with the earlier public service included.

source_document.title: CCNL Comparto Scuola 2006-2009, 29 novembre 2007

location.section: Art. 17 cc. 1, 8 (assenze per malattia)
location.quote: b) 90% della retribuzione di cui alla lett. a) per i successivi 3 mesi di assenza;

provenance.note: Job kept 18 months within the three years before the day (the CCNL sums 'le assenze per malattia verificatesi nel triennio precedente' the last episode): 540 days of 30-day months over a window of 3 years; 9 months (270 days) in full, 3 (days 271-360) at 90%, 6 (days 361-540) at 50%. The window ends on the sick day, not on the start of the last episode. The cut of the accessory pay of the first 10 days (D.L. 112/2008 art. 71 c. 1) is not modelled.

source_document.title: CCNL text with the notice clause (Art. 43, commi 1-4)

location.section: Art. 43, commi 1-4
location.quote:
anni di servizio                                 mesi di preavviso
- fino a 5                                                         2
- oltre 5 e fino a 10                                         3
- oltre 10                                                         4

2. In caso di dimissioni i termini di preavviso sono ridotti della metà.

3. I termini di preavviso decorrono dal primo giorno o dal giorno 16 di ciascun mese.

provenance.transformation: Bands proposed by a delegated search and checked band by band against the PDF by a separate session. The resignation bands are left out where halving gives a fraction of a month (the engine computes only the indemnity the employer owes on a dismissal); a start day the text does not set is read as the day after the notice; the ratei of the extra months and the TFR treatment are set only where the text states them.

reviews.scope: Tabellare, indennità di Ateneo and overtime of the university staff, 2024-2027.
findings: New file for the university staff of the comparto Istruzione e Ricerca, which the scuola file left out: tabellare of Tabella B2 by area, indennità di Ateneo of Tabella B3, overtime of Tabella B4, read on the ARAN texts.
Notice bands by level and service checked against the PDF by a separate session (delegated search and independent verification): work_rules.notice.
